notes: Prompts mix triggering tests (casual CodeLens phrasings that should pull this skill) and output-quality tests (idempotent webhook, effectively-once consumer, authenticated cross-pod WebSocket with replay, OAuth2 session security with membership checks, idempotent schema.sql with pgvector, Resilience4j with a fallback provider, the Claude SDK provider, G1 retrieval, G3 risk, G7 feedback, the demo profile). Assertions are objectively checkable.

evals.prompt: Build the endpoint that receives GitHub PR webhooks for CodeLens. GitHub sometimes delivers the same event more than once and we must not run duplicate reviews.
evals.expected_output: A controller that verifies the HMAC signature FIRST, then dedups on X-GitHub-Delivery via Redis SETNX (setIfAbsent), returns 200 for duplicates, and returns 202 after enqueuing — never runs the review inline.

assertions.text: Verifies the X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC before any other work
Dedups on X-GitHub-Delivery using Redis setIfAbsent (SETNX) with a TTL
Returns 202/Accepted after enqueuing rather than processing the review synchronously
Uses constant-time comparison (MessageDigest.isEqual) for the signature

evals.prompt: Write the worker that consumes review jobs from the Redis Stream, with a dead-letter queue for jobs that keep failing.
evals.expected_output: A consumer-group reader that skips already-reviewed (pr_id, head_sha), acks only after success, counts retries via XPENDING, and after N failures routes to a DLQ stream and marks the PR REVIEW_FAILED.

assertions.text: Reads via a Redis Streams consumer group
Acknowledges the message only after the review succeeds
Skips jobs whose (pr_id, head_sha) already has a review session
Routes to a dead-letter stream after a max retry count and marks the PR REVIEW_FAILED
Bypasses the already-reviewed skip when the job carries force=true (re-review)

evals.prompt: Configure WebSockets for CodeLens so that when we run two backend pods, a comment streamed by one pod still reaches a client connected to the other pod, only members of the repo can subscribe, and a browser that reconnects catches up on what it missed.
evals.expected_output: STOMP over SockJS with allowed origins from config, a ChannelInterceptor that requires the session's OAuth2 user on CONNECT and checks repository membership on SUBSCRIBE, a Redis Pub/Sub relay for cross-pod fan-out, and a Redis Stream replay buffer served by a @SubscribeMapping keyed on (sessionId, seq).

assertions.text: Configures STOMP endpoints with SockJS and a /topic broker
Relays messages across pods via Redis Pub/Sub (not relying on the pod-local simple broker alone)
Authenticates CONNECT and authorizes SUBSCRIBE per PR in a ChannelInterceptor (membership check)
Does not use setAllowedOriginPatterns("*")
Implements replay from a Redis buffer using sessionId + seq so reconnecting clients get missed events

evals.prompt: Set up Spring Security for CodeLens: GitHub OAuth login for the React SPA, a JSON API that answers 401 instead of redirecting, and the webhook endpoint must be reachable without a session. Users must only see PRs of repositories they belong to.
evals.expected_output: A SecurityFilterChain using OAuth2-login server-side sessions (no STATELESS policy, no JWT resource server), CSRF disabled, the webhook path permitAll (HMAC-verified), an HttpStatusEntryPoint(401) for /api/**, and membership-based checks via AccessGuard that return 404 on denial; GitHub tokens encrypted at rest and never in DTOs.

assertions.text: Uses oauth2Login with server-side sessions and does NOT set SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS
Does not configure oauth2ResourceServer().jwt() (JWT is deferred per ADR 0004/0006)
Permits the /api/webhooks/github path without authentication
Returns 401 for unauthenticated /api/** calls via an AuthenticationEntryPoint
Checks repository membership per request and answers 404 (not 403) on denial
Notes that access_token / webhook_secret must never appear in a DTO or log

evals.prompt: Give me the PostgreSQL tables for CodeLens review sessions and review comments, including whatever constraint enforces that a PR commit is reviewed only once, and the table that stores the code index for repo-aware retrieval.
evals.expected_output: Idempotent DDL (IF NOT EXISTS) for review_sessions and review_comments with UNIQUE(pr_id, head_sha), JSONB metadata, a tsvector GIN index, prompt_version/model_used plus risk and token/cost columns, and code_chunks with embedding vector(512) and an HNSW vector_cosine_ops index.

assertions.text: review_sessions has a UNIQUE(pr_id, head_sha) constraint
Includes a JSONB metadata column
Adds a GIN index on to_tsvector(comment_text) for full-text search
review_sessions records the prompt_version and model_used
code_chunks.embedding is vector(512) with an HNSW (not ivfflat) vector_cosine_ops index
Statements are idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS) and contain no DO $$ blocks

evals.prompt: Wrap the LLM calls in the CodeLens review service so a provider outage degrades gracefully instead of taking down the whole app.
evals.expected_output: Resilience4j circuit breaker + retry (backoff + jitter) + timeout + bulkhead, a fallback to the secondary provider, and degradation to REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE on full outage.

assertions.text: Applies Resilience4j retry with a fallbackMethod plus a circuit breaker
Adds retry with exponential backoff and jitter and a timeout
Falls back to the configured fallback provider and degrades to REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE when that also fails
Uses separate bulkheads for the LLM and GitHub call pools
Excludes budget-exceeded and refusal exceptions from retry (ignoreExceptions)

evals.prompt: Implement the Claude provider for CodeLens reviews using Anthropic's Java SDK. Comments should reach the browser as soon as each one is written.
evals.expected_output: An AnthropicClaudeProvider in the sealed LlmReviewProvider hierarchy that streams with client.beta().messages().createStreaming on a virtual thread bridged via Flux.create, feeds text deltas to an incremental JSON parser emitting ReviewEvent.Finding per completed comment, sends JSON-schema output_config with an explicit effort, no temperature and no thinking config, disables SDK retries, handles refusals, and ends with a Usage event.

assertions.text: Uses the official com.anthropic SDK (not raw HTTP or an OpenAI-compatible shim)
Emits each finding incrementally as its JSON object completes rather than after the full response
Sends no temperature and no thinking configuration for claude-opus-5-5
Sets maxRetries(0) so Resilience4j owns retries
Emits a Usage event with input/output tokens from the final message
Turns stop_reason=refusal into an exception or Reset rather than silently returning nothing

evals.prompt: Reviews keep missing bugs where someone changes a method signature but a caller in another file still uses the old one. Make the reviewer aware of the rest of the repository.
evals.expected_output: G1 retrieval: index the default branch into code_chunks/code_symbols (pgvector vector(512), HNSW) via an index-jobs stream, structure-aware chunking, a pluggable embedding provider with an offline default, and per-chunk retrieval ranking callers, then tests, then vector neighbours, excluding changed paths and capping context, marked untrusted in the prompt.

assertions.text: Stores code chunks in Postgres with pgvector (not a separate vector database)
Looks up exact callers of the changed symbols before vector-similar code
Indexes the default branch only, never PR head code
Caps retrieved context per chunk and excludes the changed files
Marks retrieved code as untrusted data in the prompt

evals.prompt: Add a HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW risk badge to each CodeLens PR so reviewers know which ones to look at first.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic RiskScoringService with explainable weighted factors (sensitive paths, missing tests, size, caller fan-in, findings, CRITICAL floor), clamped 0-100 with HIGH>=60 and MEDIUM>=30, persisted on the session and denormalized onto pull_requests in the review-completion transaction; the LLM only writes the summary.

assertions.text: Computes the score deterministically from named factors, each with a reason and points
Does not ask the LLM to decide the risk level
Uses HIGH >= 60 and MEDIUM >= 30 thresholds (configurable)
Persists risk on the review session and denormalizes it onto pull_requests for filtering

evals.prompt: Let reviewers thumbs-down CodeLens comments, and stop showing the kind of comment a team keeps dismissing. Votes shouldn't vanish when the PR is re-reviewed.
evals.expected_output: PUT/DELETE /api/comments/{id}/feedback upserting ON CONFLICT (comment_id, user_id); feedback keyed by repo_id + fingerprint + rule_key, detached before a re-review and re-linked by fingerprint after; per-repo suppression of rule keys with >=5 votes and >=0.7 dismiss rate, cached, bypassed by the eval; export of dismissals as must_not_flag candidates.

assertions.text: Stores one vote per user per comment via an upsert
Re-links feedback to the new comment by a stable fingerprint after a re-review
Suppresses a rule per repository based on vote count and dismiss rate thresholds
Keeps the eval path unaffected by suppression

evals.prompt: I want people to try CodeLens without creating a GitHub OAuth app or having an API key, and I want E2E tests to run against the real backend.
evals.expected_output: A demo Spring profile: seeded users/repo/PRs reviewed through the real pipeline, a loopback-only demo login that creates a real OAuth2AuthenticationToken session, a network-free GitHub client, the offline LLM, a reset endpoint, and a startup guard refusing prod or real OAuth credentials.

assertions.text: Confines demo controllers to @Profile("demo") so they 404 otherwise
Creates a real session (OAuth2AuthenticationToken) so REST and STOMP auth run unchanged
Restricts demo login to loopback callers and refuses to start alongside prod or real OAuth credentials
Seeds data through the real review pipeline rather than inserting fake review rows
